bio: Steeped in tradition, this restaurant in the Oberwinterthur district has received a modern makeover thanks to Markus Burkhard and his partner Flavia Hiestand. In an inviting setting, diners are treated to attentive service and a three- or four-course set menu crafted from select Swiss ingredients – composed according to their personal preferences. Flavoursome dishes such as cauliflower, lettuce, almond, bream dumplings, crab bisque, watercress, or beef, carrot, lettuce reflect the excellent, precise craftsmanship of Markus Burkhard, who made a name for himself as head chef at Jakobs ESSZIMMER in Rapperswil. The garden terrace, shaded by plane trees, is a real highlight too. Tip for motorists: There is a public multi-storey car park close by....
